description: This file defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables for testing configurations and creates a scoped Vitest configuration for an extension, combining environment-based settings with default patterns and configuration options.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for tests from environment variables, defaulting to the 'OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE' variable.

methods.name: export function createExtensionAcpxVitestConfig( createExtensionAcpxVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for an extension, including test patterns and setup files.
